configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: SHARED libeventprop_c_api. Build this before EventProp.C.Tests, EventProp.Native.ParityTests and EventProp.Native.Benchmarks, which import it from ./build.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised. ASan requires a Debug build.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Instrumented. On macOS this builds a STATIC libeventprop_c_api.a (AppleClang cannot instrument shared libraries). Build this before the asan preset in EventProp.C.Tests — both sides must be instrumented consistently. Output lands in ./build, the path the test project hardcodes.

configurePresets.name: werror
configurePresets.description: Enforces the 'code must compile with zero warnings' rule. Separate build dir so it never clobbers the release build.
